title: Payment service rejects every charge

expected_root_cause.description: payment service fails 100% of charge requests (feature flag paymentFailure=100%)

expected_signals: payment error spans/logs; checkout PlaceOrder errors; frontend 5xx on /api/checkout; no host or container resource anomaly

title: Payment service unavailable

expected_root_cause.description: checkout cannot reach the payment service (paymentUnreachable=on)

expected_signals: connection errors from checkout to payment; checkout latency/timeouts; payment itself healthy

title: Cart service fails half of requests

expected_root_cause.description: cart service errors on ~50% of requests (cartFailure=50%)

expected_signals: intermittent cart errors; AddItem/GetCart failures; error rate ~50% not 100%

title: Product catalog fails on a specific product

expected_root_cause.description: GetProduct fails for one product id (productCatalogFailure=on)

expected_signals: errors only for a specific product id; other products fine

expected_root_cause.description: recommendation service cache misbehaves, causing memory growth and latency (recommendationCacheFailure=on)

title: Ad service CPU spike
expected_signals: ad container CPU up; ad GetAds latency up; host CPU up

title: Kafka queue overload with consumer delay

expected_root_cause.description: Kafka overloaded while consumers are delayed, causing lag (kafkaQueueProblems=on)

expected_signals: consumer lag; accounting/fraud-detection processing delay; kafka CPU up

title: Email service memory leak
expected_signals: email container memory grows steadily; possible OOM restart

title: Slow image loading
expected_signals: image-provider response time ~10s; frontend page load slow; no errors

title: Currency container stopped
expected_signals: container die/stop event; currency metrics disappear; callers get connection refused / unavailable

title: Network latency to product-catalog

expected_root_cause.description: 800ms +-200ms added on product-catalog's network interface (tc netem)

expected_signals: product-catalog server-side spans fast but client spans slow; no errors; no CPU/memory anomaly

title: Host CPU saturated by unrelated container

expected_root_cause.description: a stress container saturates all host CPUs; every service slows down

expected_signals: host CPU ~100%; rca-stress top consumer; latency up across many unrelated services
